automation: No AI provider is callable from this repository's CI: no ANTHROPIC/OPENAI credential exists in the workflows or requirements, and adding one is an Owner decision. Every review is therefore written by an agent session (MANUAL_AGENT_SESSION) from the committed packet alone and committed through commit-reveal. desk.py marks the cohort AI_REVIEW_REQUIRED until that happens.

reviewers.note: The 2026-11 B2 review (ai-reviews/2026-11.json) was written by this reviewer.
Enable by setting status ENABLED in a committed change before a cohort's packet is sealed. Produces BX:gpt records; never replaces B2.
A second Claude session that has not seen the primary review; measures reviewer-to-reviewer variance.

rules.enableBeforeSeal: a reviewer enabled after a cohort's packet was sealed does not take part in that cohort
rules.sameInputs: every reviewer of a cohort reads the same sealed packet; reading sources dated after the cutoff is forbidden and the review must say so in knowledgeLimit
rules.noBackfill: an idea produced outside the cohort window (for example in a chat) is never registered as a cohort signal
